# Step - constant

`constant` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Replaces every incoming value with the given constant.

## Forms

```text
constant(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("software").constant("app").to_list()   // ["app", "app"]
```
